Local MVP — built from real Gemini-3.5-flash-lite eval data, 41 runs across 5 batches (14 curated + 5 custom trip requests, some with multiple runs over time). Decision (Pass/Fail) uses the scoring rule designed this session: weighted check average, capped at 5.9 whenever any confirmed High exists, FAIL if score ≤ 7. Action items/status save to this browser's local storage only — not shared yet. Next step: Supabase-backed shared state for review actions.
